chapters.title: DC entry
chapters.description: One dendritic cell brings nine finite antigen packets into a quiet tissue.

chapters.title: T-cell priming
chapters.description: A compatible local DC–CD4 contact starts a timed priming program.

chapters.title: Border helper
chapters.description: The primed CD4 cell acquires a border-helper program.

chapters.title: Linked B–T help
chapters.description: A local cognate B–helper contact can license B-cell output.

chapters.title: Help completed
chapters.description: Linked help completes; the helper becomes Tfh. B-cell fates remain individual choices.

chapters.title: Germinal center
chapters.description: Qualified founders and timed organization create a local GC.

chapters.title: Plasmablast
chapters.description: One helped B cell completes plasmablast differentiation.

chapters.title: First IgM output
chapters.description: After differentiation, the antibody-producing cell starts releasing its clone’s IgM output.

chapters.title: Cell division
chapters.description: Two daughters replace one parent. Their recorded lineage and clone are preserved.

chapters.title: Plasma cell
chapters.description: The plasmablast matures into a plasma cell and continues secreting IgM.

chapters.title: Failed GC selection
chapters.description: Unsuccessful GC cells undergo apoptosis. These outcomes remain in the recording.

chapters.title: GC resolution
chapters.description: The local GC resolves after failed selection; the plasma cell continues output.
